en: Black‑and‑white view along a dusty village street lined with plastered and timber houses with steep tiled roofs and vines growing up the walls. A few women and a child carry buckets along the road. At the end of the street rises a large Gothic-style church with a prominent tower and spire. The scene has an early 20th‑century rural Central European atmosphere. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
